reasoning_contract.selected_delta: Pinned SDK chooses first nonempty string perchunk: reasoning_content, reasoning, reasoning_text. Empty aliases skipped; never sum all aliases from one chunk.
reasoning_contract.signature: ensureThinkingBlock creates one block with first selected signature; opencode-go initial reasoning normalizes to reasoning_content. Subsequent alias changes append into same block without replacing first signature.
reasoning_contract.next_request: SDK filters thinking.trim().length>0 blocks, preserves retained text byte values, joins with literal newline and uses first retained block signature. opencode-go reasoning normalizes. Compat inserts empty reasoning_content only when absent. No extra whitespace normalization.
reasoning_contract.reasoning_text_edge: First signature reasoning_text produces reasoning_text joined bytes AND reasoning_content:"". Do not claim all aliases become nonempty reasoning_content or rewrite SDK history. Verify exact presence/map; real provider support remains later qualification observation.
reasoning_contract.unsupported: No encrypted reasoning_details/signature alternatives, thinking-as-visible-text or grammar/customtools silently accepted under fixedpolicy; those require separate scope.
reasoning_contract.proof: For each ordinal original sealed SSE raw/digest -> actual SDK thinking text/signature/content order -> every previous assistant wire reasoning field in next MODEL. Remove/change/reorder/inject reasoning must fail even if visible text/tools identical. All tool/consumed-command rounds included.
reasoning_contract.raw: Original SSE bytes/digest/receipt_id and actual SDK history retained. Semantic explanation never substitutes rewritten raw evidence.
